Getting Started with Widgets

Widgets are small building blocks. This guide shows how to install and use them in your project.

They work everywhere, from small scripts to large applications, with no configuration required.

Installation

Run the following command in your terminal:

npm install widgets

Usage

Follow these steps to ship your first widget:

  • Create a widget
  • Configure it
  • Ship it

Read the API reference or the team blog for more details.
